project_info.theme: Shopee Mall Super Brand Day mood-chill bodycare campaign
project_info.color_palette: Soft sky blue, mint green, white, coral orange, botanical gold

main_subject.detail: A soft airy multi-brand bodycare poster with top logos for Xmen For Boss, Xmen, Lashe Superfood, Purite de Provence, Oliv, and Shopee Mall Super Brand Day. Giant headline reads 'CHON HUONG CHUAN GU MUI CHAT, MOOD CHILL (*)'. Three pale green offer boxes say 'DEAL DOC QUYEN', 'VOUCHER LEN DEN 25%', and '10.000 QUA TANG'. The product lineup includes a black Xmen Aqua Sport body wash, a pink Purite de Provence shimmering shower gel bottle, a black Xmen For Boss Pro roll-on, a Lashe Superfood facial-wash tube, and a transparent golden Oliv bottle. Bottom CTA says 'MUA NGAY TAI SHOPEE' and the footnote reads '(*) Mood Chill: Chi tam trang thoai mai, nhe nhang, thu gian'.
main_subject.style: Clean floating product-collage beauty poster with fresh botanical mood, premium packshot focus, and bright super-brand-day merchandising
